pathAssistantSteps.info:
Log where it came from (SAM.gov notice, agency forecast, industry day) and a rough value.

Decide within two weeks whether it's worth qualifying.

Pursue gate: it fits our strategy, it's funded, and we can be competitive.

Assign a Capture Manager and confirm the vehicle and acquisition type.

Meet the customer, shape the requirement, line up teammates and work out price-to-win.

Set the Incumbent: Competitor Intel shows our record against them and the margin we win at.

Bid/no-bid review on the final or draft RFP: Pwin, margin, capacity and teaming.

Not bidding? Move to No Bid with a reason.

Run the color-team reviews (Pink, Red, Gold) before submission.

Contract floors: Cost Plus 7%, T&M 10%, Fixed Price 12%. The Margin Guardrail shows the gap.

Below the floor? Submit for Pricing Review now: the opportunity can't move to Proposal Submitted until it's approved. Regenerate the Pricing Rationale with Einstein for the approver.

Track the evaluation and set Close Date to the expected award date.

Prepare for discussions: likely evaluation notices and price pressure.

Answer evaluation notices and submit the final proposal revision.

Changing the price or contract type resets the margin approval: check the Guardrail before you commit.
Create Contract on Win sets up the Contract from this award. Schedule the kickoff and hand over to the Program Manager.

Loss Reason is required. Set Lost To for the winning competitor: it feeds Competitor Intel and the Margin & Competition dashboard.

Request a debrief within three days of the award notice.
Record why we passed. No Bid deals stay out of win rates.
